about: INDIRECT (ADR-0124's note of 2026-10-10, docs/specs/exsheet-functions ticket 18, SH-59, SH-68): a volatile function, so what the corpus cannot state is here: the place its text names read as it stands after each recalculation, whatever the change, and a Formula that reaches itself through it. The forms it reads and refuses are in ExcelCases/indirect.json; the R1C1, structured and A1# forms the Windows runs and the area passes observed are read here as the Formula forms they name are, cycles, waits and spills included, with those that follow from them by the rule they settle; the forms those leave open are refused and asked by the corpus. microsoftsExample is B2 1.333, B3 45, B4 10, B5 62. Transcribed from ExSheet.Engine.Tests' IndirectTests.
